title: Uniqueness of the vector measure of a current on ℝ^N on Borel sets (Simon 2.7–2.9)
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ and X ∈ D_k(ℝ^N) (GeometricCurrentOn univ k). Let (μ₁, v₁) and (μ₂, v₂) be measure representations of X (IsMeasureRepresentation X μ_i v_i: for every test form ω on ℝ^N the function x ↦ v_i(x)(ω(x)) is μ_i-integrable and X(ω) = ∫ v_i(x)(ω(x)) dμ_i). Then (a) ∫_A v₁(x)(ω(x)) dμ₁ = ∫_A v₂(x)(ω(x)) dμ₂ for every Borel set A ⊆ ℝ^N and every test form ω; and (b) ∫_A v₁(x)(α) dμ₁ = ∫_A v₂(x)(α) dμ₂ for every bounded Borel set A ⊆ ℝ^N and every k-covector α.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k) (μ₁ μ₂ : Measure (Eucl N)) (v₁ v₂ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), IsMeasureRepresentation X μ₁ v₁ → IsMeasureRepresentation X μ₂ v₂ → (∀ A : Set (Eucl N), MeasurableSet A → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, ∫ x in A, v₁ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x) ∂μ₁ = ∫ x in A, v₂ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x) ∂μ₂) ∧ (∀ A : Set (Eucl N), MeasurableSet A → Bornology.IsBounded A → ∀ α : Covector (Eucl N) k, ∫ x in A, v₁ x α ∂μ₁ = ∫ x in A, v₂ x α ∂μ₂)
